items.title: Aurora Demo Clip
items.description: A small locally generated clip that ships with Aurora. Replace it with your own files, or scan a folder from Settings (F3).

items.title: Demo Episode
items.description: Put series here. Point "file" at an episode, or scan a folder whose path contains tv, series, or season.

items.title: Demo Tone
items.description: A short test tone. Audio keeps playing while you browse the rest of the library.

items.title: Demo Slide 1
items.description: Pictures open as a fullscreen slideshow. The interval is set in Settings (F3).

items.title: Demo Slide 2
items.description: Use the arrow keys to move through the slideshow, or +10 / -10 to skip.

items.title: Demo Slide 3
items.description: Press Esc to close the slideshow and return to the library.

items.title: Notepad
items.description: Launches Notepad on Windows, or gedit/kate/mousepad on Linux.

items.title: Calculator
items.description: Launches Calculator on Windows, or gnome-calculator/kcalc on Linux.

items.title: Paint
items.description: Launches Paint on Windows, or Pinta/KolourPaint on Linux.
